prose: Lindsey Scharmyn of Rogue Ways had me on her show to finish up the analysis of the Transhuman Tarot from Cyberpunk 2077. The latter half of the Major Arcana were definitely as deep as the first, and it's always fascinating to follow that legendary Path of the Fool on another journey, albeit a dark one this time around.
You'll want to either watch the video version of this episode or download the slide images (linked below), so you can follow along with what we're looking at.
ext: See us complete the analysis of all Major Arcana cards.
